outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic-style diagram illustrating camera exposure time vs illumination overhead with percentage labels; it is not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel B is a line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points as overlaying them would make the plot unreadable.
Panel C shows mean ΔROS values connected/plotted against exposure time with error bars in a scatter/line style plot; this type is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel D displays individual migration tracks for each single cell (each line represents one cell's path), so individual data are already shown.
Panel E is a bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each cell, satisfying the requirement.
Panel F consists of micrograph images (MitoTracker, Paxillin, Merge) and does not present averaged quantitative data requiring individual points.
Panel G is a micrograph time-series and does not show averaged data.
Panel H is a micrograph time-series and does not show averaged data.
Panel I is a line plot of normalized cell area over time with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel J is a line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
